content:
#1 In 'simplicial groups' there is an ambiguous phrase in the Idea section:

$\bullet$ [a simplicial group is ...] a model for a topological space with a group structure.

Does that mean:

( [a simplicial group is ...] a model for a topological space) with a group structure

or

[a simplicial group is ...] a model (for a topological space with a group structure)

The first version is true, but is the second one true, too? (Means
a simplicial group is a model for a topological group)
subject: ambiguous

content: #2 The geometric realization of a simplicial group is a topological group. (More invariantly, simplicial groups model all infinity-groups.)
subject: ambiguous
